answer.explanation: The visible events show no errors, timeouts, throttles or permission failures. Every invocation has an END and REPORT line, and durations are consistent across the window (CrudApi about 24-45 ms, Uploader about 80-200 ms, Thumbnailer about 90-180 ms, Compression about 530-650 ms). Max memory used stays well below the allocated size for every function (for example about 100 MB of 1024 MB on Compression and Thumbnailer, about 100 MB of 256 MB on Uploader and CrudApi). The 4336 truncated events could not be inspected, so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
